actions.action: Require a receipt before marking a key handoff complete.
actions.mechanism: Separate an offered handoff from confirmed possession so an unanswered message cannot silently change the holder.
actions.implementation: Use two messages: “Key offered: A → B” and B’s “Received at [date, time, timezone].” Until receipt, show “Last confirmed holder: A; handoff to B unresolved.” Initialize possession with one volunteer’s confirmation.
actions.check: Offer a handoff without replying: it must remain unresolved. Add the recipient’s timestamped receipt: B must become the confirmed holder.
actions.risk: A delayed receipt leaves recorded possession behind reality; label it last confirmed, not certain.

actions.action: Keep a handoff ledger instead of editing away mistakes.
actions.mechanism: Preserve the sequence of transfers and make corrections explicit.
actions.implementation: Give each handoff an ID. Record sender, recipient, physical transfer time, and pending/received/cancelled status in a shared note. Correct errors with a dated entry referencing the ID; distinguish transfer time from entry time. Either existing volunteer can maintain it.
actions.check: Enter a receipt late and then correct its transfer time. Both the original entry and correction must remain visible, with one effective transfer time.
actions.risk: Manual entries can conflict; flag conflicting receipts as unresolved rather than choosing one silently.

actions.action: Pin a compact key-status card at the top of the chat.
actions.mechanism: Separate the current answer from conversational history and surface unfinished transfers.
actions.implementation: Maintain one pinned message containing last confirmed holder, confirmation time, and every unresolved handoff ID with its start time. Update it after each offer, receipt, cancellation, or correction; link to the corresponding ledger entries.
actions.check: After a completed transfer followed by an unanswered offer, each volunteer must identify the last confirmed holder and the pending transfer using only the pinned card; verify against the ledger.
actions.risk: The card can become stale. Display its update time and flag any mismatch with the ledger.
